notes.problem: Flat grey mid-tone slab with no bright edge, brown groove, a diagram at 432 px.
notes.fix: Rake the key along the graduations for a hot specular line on the bevel and stop block top, mat to true black, groove to lit dusk_gold enamel.

notes.problem: Mid-grey slab, stair-stepped cast, muddy groove, graduations alias, dead band between hook and dek.
notes.fix: Dark stainless on a near-black mat, grazing key, taller stop block, smoother shadow, groove albedo within 12 Lab of the accent, close the hook to dek gap.

notes.problem: Mid-grey plate with ribbed grey stripes above, stair-stepped cast, a grey rectangle with ticks at 432 px.
notes.fix: A narrow, brightly keyed steel bar on a near-black mat, drop the ribbed band, taller stop block with a long smooth cast, grooves running out at the right edge as the brightest thing.

notes.problem: Slumped figure behind a seat back, wheel far right untouched, hands at the bottom edge, no road through the windshield.
notes.fix: Passenger-seat camera at seated eye, driver's seat and wheel together in the left half, hands on the rim, windshield open to the road and seam on the right.

notes.problem: Person slumped in the near seat, wheel empty across the cab, black windshield, pale slab, stray rod, headliner edges cross the dek.
notes.fix: Passenger-seat camera, person upright behind the wheel, hands on the rim, windshield open to road and seam, delete slab and rod.

notes.problem: Figure slumped looking at the lap, wheel on the right with no one behind it, flat greys, mannequin.
notes.fix: Passenger-side camera with the wheel in front of the seated person, head raised, hands at the rim, side-glass key on face and hands, road and seam through the windshield.

notes.problem: Column mostly in shadow, muddy near third, leaders cross the cars.
notes.fix: Square the camera to the column, light its near half, labels at the end of their rows with leaders under 60 px.

notes.problem: Leaders cross lit cars, ITE label collides, dividers flecks, near rows unlit.
notes.fix: Labels on dark asphalt beside each run without leaders, pool on the near rows, full-width divider bars.

notes.problem: Leader lines cross, ITE dot on its own label, which run belongs to which company unclear.
notes.fix: Pin each label at the head of its own run beside its divider without crossing leaders.

notes.problem: Lone car in front of a full row, empty bays a sliver, comb shadow from the left edge.
notes.fix: Lower the camera into the ITE row so nine empty bays lead to the one car, remove the off-frame caster.

notes.problem: Lone car in front of full rows, bays and stops only at lower right.
notes.fix: Camera at the empty end of the row so nine open bays with lit stops lead back to the single car.

notes.problem: Cold blue-grey cars, full rows instead of tail rows, generic skyline.
notes.fix: Warm key on the near flanks, frame the tail rows with single cars and empty bays.

notes.problem: Blue-violet cars, block skyline with a stray sphere, empty bottom 40 percent.
notes.fix: Cut the cool fill, remove the sphere, tilt down so tail rows fill the lower half.

notes.problem: Mannequin figure from behind, faint mesh cast.
notes.fix: Crop the figure to shoulders and cap at the left edge, harden the fence's cast.
